name.zh: 调整速度安排出手先后
name.en: Tune speed to arrange turn order

summary.zh: 让先手留给铺垫者，再让收割者接上。
summary.en: Let a setup unit act before the finisher.

rules.zh: 玩家通过配装、属性或状态改变单位的出手先后，让减防、治疗与攻击按需要衔接。速度不一定增加行动次数；还要看敌我是否交替、每轮是否重排。行动队列或实际出手结果给出反馈。
rules.en: Change initiative through equipment, stats or effects so debuffs, healing and attacks arrive in a useful order. Speed need not grant more actions: alternation and per-round rerolls also matter. A timeline or the resolved order gives feedback.

loop.zh: 根据敌方先手重新安排
loop.en: Revise the order around enemy turns

decisions.zh: 让治疗者抢先保命，还是让控制者先压住危险敌人？
decisions.en: Should the healer act first to save someone, or should control suppress the threat?

decisions.zh: 为抢先手牺牲伤害，能否换来少挨一次攻击？
decisions.en: Does sacrificing damage for initiative prevent an enemy action?

effect.zh: 随机越大，精确连招越不稳定，更需要备用计划。
effect.en: More randomness weakens exact sequencing and makes backup plans matter.

effect.zh: 每轮重排方便局间调整；实时重排会让加速效果更难预测。
effect.en: Round boundaries make changes easier to anticipate; immediate reordering is harder to read.

implementation.zh: 每轮以速度加随机值决定行动先后，高速度提高先动机会，但不是绝对保证。
implementation.en: Each round adds a random value to Speed to determine order, so high Speed improves the chance of acting early without guaranteeing it.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：复用已收录的本作截图提供场景语境，不能单凭画面确认本条的完整规则。
observation.en: System reference: an existing screenshot from this game supplies context, not proof of this complete rule.

implementation.zh: 先攻值决定队伍内谁先行动，敌我通常交替出手；堆高全队先攻并不意味着全队连续行动。
implementation.en: Initiative orders party members while the two sides normally alternate; raising everyone’s initiative does not make the whole party act consecutively.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：复用已收录的本作截图提供场景语境，不能单凭画面确认本条的完整规则。
observation.en: System reference: an existing screenshot from this game supplies context, not proof of this complete rule.

contrast.zh: 暗黑地牢加入每轮随机性；神界原罪2还用敌我交替限制连续先手。
contrast.en: Darkest Dungeon adds round-by-round uncertainty; Original Sin 2 additionally constrains initiative through alternating sides.

combination.zh: 组合提案：将敌人意图与队列放在一起，玩家发现敌人下一次将放大招后，再给打断者换上加速装备。
combination.en: Design proposal: show enemy intent beside the queue, letting players equip a speed boost on the interrupter before a major attack.

setup.zh: 敌人将在第三位释放大范围攻击，我方治疗者第二位、控制者第四位。
setup.en: The enemy’s area attack is third; the healer is second and the controller fourth.

action.zh: 把加速饰品从治疗者换给控制者。
action.en: Move a speed trinket from the healer to the controller.

result.zh: 控制者提前行动，先压住敌人。
result.en: The controller acts sooner and suppresses the enemy.

next.zh: 面对持续失血的下一战，再考虑恢复治疗者先手。
next.en: Against bleeding in the next fight, reconsider giving the healer priority.

firstStep.zh: 做四个单位和一条排序队列，只提供一件改变速度的装备。
firstStep.en: Build four units and a turn queue with one speed-changing item.

pitfall.zh: 别把速度、行动点与行动次数混成一个难读数值。
pitfall.en: Keep initiative, action points and action count distinct.

test.zh: 玩家能否在开战前说出调整后谁会先动，以及这样做的目的？
test.en: Can players predict the changed order and explain why they want it?
